tools/syscall-diff/probe.c run_real arguments already in this tree
output/syscall-diff/windows.log and output/syscall-diff/reactos-before.log, both containing DIFF END OK

harness.name: NtCreateFile

cursor.prompt: Milestone 8: NtCreateFile. Implement the plan as specified.

measuredEffect.metric: amd64 probe exact status match percent
measuredEffect.note: Both numbers are 101 names under the same exact-status rule: 81 matches before, 86 after. NtCreateFile moved from STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED to STATUS_SUCCESS. NtReadFile, NtWriteFile, NtClose, and NtDeviceIoControlFile also matched because that create returned a handle. No other top-100 status changed. CDFS was left unchanged. No kernel or fastfat change was required.
